observation: In a git worktree the relative core.hooksPath resources/githooks resolves inside the worktree, where the gitignored generated agent-loop-hooks.env is absent, so the pre-commit hook ran vendor/bin/agent-loop and failed. init sync-githooks --dry-run would rewrite the shared core.hooksPath to .githooks for every worktree.

evidence.summary: git commit in a fresh worktree failed with vendor/bin/agent-loop: No such file or directory; the same commit with AGENT_LOOP_BIN=bin/agent-loop passed the hooks.

hypothesis: Generated hook environment is per-checkout state while core.hooksPath is shared repository config.
validated_conclusion: Git hooks in a worktree need the hook environment without mutating shared core.hooksPath; AGENT_LOOP_BIN=bin/agent-loop runs the unmodified hooks correctly.
